title: Fsm Statechart Technology
description: Build a new top-level `fsm` technology: a full XState/Stately-parity statechart system in Rust. Two crates: `fsm/rs` (package `fsm` — pure SCXML-style run-to-completion kernel, actor runtime, host abstraction native/WASM/test, persistence, inspection, model-based testing tooling, wasm bridge) and `fsm/macros/rs` (package `fsm_macros`, proc-macro crate — StatechartEvent/StatechartSchema derives + `statechart!` DSL macro). Machine structure is compile-time (dense static tables, u16 NodeIds, no HashMap/string dispatch at runtime); active configuration is a hand-rolled bitset (not one enum) to support parallel regions. Guards pure, reducers separated from effects, kernel emits Command enum (Effect/Raise/Send/Emit/StartInvoke/StopInvoke/Schedule/CancelTimer) rather than executing them. Full plan with file-by-file region layout, public API sketch, DSL grammar example, build/task wiring (Cargo workspace members, package.json/project.json/script.ts mirroring draw/rs), and a 10-step implementation sequence is saved at /Users/ueli/.claude/plans/fsm-lib-rs-create-a-new-sprightly-plum.md — follow it precisely. Consumers this eventually replaces: cad/rs InteractionSpec, cad/plugin/rs/interaction.rs, cad/machine/stately (XState) — out of scope for this ticket, follow-up only.
